description: Map a free-text phrase such as "scrape product pages" to canonical capability IDs. Use it before the capabilities filter of list_agents or plan_work when you know the need but not the ID; for the whole taxonomy use get_capabilities. Returns {canonical_ids, families, matches, ambiguous, unknown, suggestions}; ambiguous or unknown terms come back with suggestions instead of a guess. Public data; no account or API key needed. Free.

q.description: Capability phrase to resolve, e.g. "web scraping"

name: resolve_capabilities
title: Resolve capability text
